name: Creeper Ichor
summary: Across the Hillsbrad forests, rare, virulent Creeper Ichor is harvested from moss creepers. The Royal Apothecary Society in Tarren Mill seeks it as a biological agent for formulating novel plagues against the living.

sections.title: Apothecary Research in Hillsbrad
sections.body: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon seeks natural toxins and biological catalysts to craft deadly new toxins and eradicate the surrounding human population. The clean air and vibrant life of the foothills offend him. Among the forest’s giant arachnids, mature moss creepers hold an elusive ichor that makes an ideal base for his Elixir of Suffering. Mixed with other reagents, including gray bear tongues, the fluid helps the Forsaken perfect their lethal alchemy.

faq.answer: Moss creepers throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills yield the fluid. They include Giant Moss Creepers, Forest Moss Creepers, Elder Moss Creepers, and the notable arachnid Creepthess.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon need this fluid?
aliases: what is creeper ichor used for
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon uses Creeper Ichor as a vital killing agent in his ongoing alchemical research. It helps him brew the Elixir of Suffering, designed to plague and exterminate the living humans in Hillsbrad.

faq.q: Why is Creeper Ichor so difficult to find?
faq.answer: Moss creepers are common in the forests around Tarren Mill, but usable reservoirs of this virulent ichor are uncommon. Hunters may have to slay many arachnids before securing a usable specimen.

angles.text: As a Forsaken loyalist, securing lethal components like Creeper Ichor directly advances the Royal Apothecary Society’s campaign to scour the living from Lordaeron.
